title: Three memory regimes of a long context
caption: The book's log-log plot of weights, per-request KV cache, and one layer's materialized scores against context length - the quantitative version of our prefill-decode sketch. Ours shows the two-phase mechanism; theirs shows where the three curves actually cross (~10K and ~41K tokens).

title: Architecture workload profiles table
caption: The table this whole packet compresses into the signature cards: per-family persistent state, per-request activations, intensity regime, parallel axis, and limiting iron-law term. Read the transformer's two rows - same weights, different bottleneck.

title: Arithmetic intensity across workloads
caption: The lighthouse models placed on one intensity axis with machine-balance ridges - the ~160x ResNet/GPT-2-decode gap our chart approximates qualitatively. Theirs is the measured version; check where each lighthouse sits relative to the roofline knee.

title: Architecture selection flowchart
caption: The triage tree the packet calls 'selection as elimination': data type picks candidate families, then memory, compute, latency, accuracy, and deployment diamonds filter - with recommendation workloads routed to the sparse family first. The packet's D·A·M reading is this chart's one-line summary.

title: Attention memory wall (margin)
caption: The book's margin sketch of quadratic score memory versus linear KV growth - compare with our prefill-decode strip. Theirs motivates tiled attention kernels; ours motivates why decode serving is the bill.

title: Inductive bias spectrum (margin)
caption: The book's ordering of families by assumption strength. The packet adds RNNs between CNN and transformer (recurrence fixes order but not which positions matter) - check whether you agree with the placement.

title: Capacity wall (margin)
caption: The book's version of our capacity-wall sketch. Compare escapes: theirs frames it as an HBM/DRAM/NVLink placement ladder, ours as three explicit trade-offs (shrink/move/partition).
